note: Google nantit ses bons de souscription TeraWulf (« Google Warrants ») au profit des porteurs des obligations garanties 2030 de 3 200,0 M$ émises par Wulf Compute LLC (filiale de TeraWulf) pour financer le campus Lake Mariner loué à Fluidstack ; sûreté levée au début des baux HPC de Fluidstack ou au remboursement des obligations ; date relative à l'émission du 22 octobre 2025, non reprise
quote: Additionally, in connection with the 2030 Secured Notes, Google and the Company entered into a pledge agreement. Under the pledge agreement, Google assigned and pledged to the collateral agent, its successors and permitted assigns, for the benefit of the lenders, and granted to the collateral agent, its successors and permitted assigns, for the benefit of the lenders, a security interest in all of Google's right, title and interest in, to and under the Google Warrants.
trigger_description: The security interests associated with the Google Warrants shall automatically terminate and/or be released upon the earlier of (i) the occurrence of the commencement date of the respective Fluidstack HPC Leases and the (ii) the payment and discharge in full of the 2030 Secured Notes.

note: engagement inconditionnel d'une société affiliée de Google, envers l'agent des sûretés des obligations 2030, de payer l'indemnité de résiliation prévue par les accords de reconnaissance Google (baux HPC de Fluidstack à Lake Mariner) ; soutien de crédit au financement de TeraWulf ; montant non chiffré dans ce bloc
quote: In connection with the 2030 Secured Notes, an affiliate of Google unconditionally agreed with the collateral agent for the benefit of the lenders that it shall (or shall cause Google to) pay the Termination Fee in accordance with the timing requirements set forth in the respective Google Recognition Agreements.
trigger_description: pay the Termination Fee in accordance with the timing requirements set forth in the respective Google Recognition Agreements
